adopt.title: Adopt project: {{name}}
adopt.note: This OpenStack project is not managed here yet. Adopting places it under a budget; the next synchronization run then sends it through the normal approval flow. Its current members are kept.
adopt.ownerHint: The person who will be responsible for this project.
adopt.ownerRequired: Please enter the owner’s email address
adopt.budgetPlaceholder: Choose the budget that provides the resources
adopt.budgetsOwnerCanRequest: Budgets the owner can request under
adopt.purposeRequired: Please describe the purpose (at least 5 characters)
adopt.externalGroups: This project has OpenStack groups assigned outside this system; they are preserved automatically.

approve.title: Approve: {{name}}
approve.budgetNote: This approves a <1>budget</1>: its managers can then approve requests and delegate further within the granted cap.
approve.adjustHint: Approve with an adjusted allocation instead of what was requested.

budgetCard.managedByHint: They approve requests and can pass parts of this budget on.

budgetForm.requestFromHint: The budget that will provide the resources — its managers approve your request.
budgetForm.requestFromRequired: Please choose the budget to request from
budgetForm.name: Name
budgetForm.nameHint: A short, recognizable name, e.g. “CS Department” or “AI Lab WS26”.
budgetForm.nameRequired: Please give the budget a name (at least 3 characters)
budgetForm.purposeRequired: Please describe what this budget is for (at least 5 characters)
budgetForm.endDateNeeded: The budget above ends on {{date}}, so this one needs an end date too
budgetForm.endDateAfterParent: The budget above ends on {{date}} — this one cannot run longer
budgetForm.adminScopeRequired: Name at least one person or group — a budget nobody manages appears in nobody’s “My Budgets”, and requests under it land with the budget above instead
budgetForm.shortensSubtree: Everything below this budget that runs longer — sub-budgets, projects and open requests — will end on {{date}} too.
budgetForm.resourceCapHint: The maximum everything under this budget may use in total.
budgetForm.managedByHint: These people or groups run this budget: they approve requests, change its settings and can pass parts of it on as sub-budgets. Their own projects here are created without approval.
budgetForm.requestersHint: These people or groups may create projects from this budget, without any say over it. Their projects wait for a manager’s approval unless auto-approve covers them. Leave empty to disable requests.
budgetForm.allowBudgetRequests: Also allow budget requests in addition to projects
budgetForm.allowBudgetRequestsHint: A requester can then ask for a budget of their own here and delegate further. Turn this off for a course budget that should only ever hold projects — managers can always create sub-budgets directly.
budgetForm.allowBudgetRequestsInactive: Only relevant once somebody may request here.
budgetForm.autoApproveNoRequesters: Nobody may request from this budget yet, so there is nothing to approve automatically. Add people or groups under <1>Access → “Who can request here”</1> first; this tab becomes editable as soon as somebody is listed.
budgetForm.autoApproveHint: Projects from the people under “Who can request here” are created immediately, without a manager, as long as this budget has room — and so are later changes to them that stay within it. What happens beyond that is the next switch.
budgetForm.allowBeyondOn: What auto-approve does not cover waits for a manager. Switch off to make it a hard limit.
budgetForm.allowBeyondOff: Off: what auto-approve does not cover is refused right away — nothing waits for a manager. The managers of this budget are not limited.
budgetForm.individualOn: Each person gets at most the amounts below, summed over all their projects here — the setup for a course.
budgetForm.individualOff: Off: everybody draws from the whole budget until it is used up — the setup for a personal or team pool. Switch on to give each person a fixed share.
budgetForm.neverNeedApproval: Whatever is set here: giving resources back, ending a project sooner and changing its members never need an approval.

budgets.deleteMessage: Only possible while nothing under it is active or awaiting a decision.
budgets.releaseMessage: Releasing removes the project and its resources from OpenStack. This cannot be undone.
budgets.intro: The budgets you manage, as a tree.
budgets.introWithRequestable: The budgets you manage, plus the ones you may request from (read-only).
budgets.introSelect: Select a node to inspect it; delegate by creating a sub-budget with someone else in “Managed by”.
budgets.none: You don't manage any budgets yet. A manager of a parent budget can delegate one to you.
budgets.noneCanRequest: You don't manage any budgets yet. You can request one from a budget that accepts sub-budget requests.
budgets.shown: Budgets shown: {{shown}}/{{total}}. Use the search to find the ones not listed.
budgets.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting for your decision.

endDate.label: End date
endDate.setEndDateHint: Off means the budget runs until somebody changes it.
endDate.atMost: At most until {{date}}, when its budget ends.

fact.canRequestEmpty: Nobody — only its managers can put anything here

inspect.managedByEmpty: Managers of the parent budgets only

memberEditor.placeholder: Search and add users or groups…
memberEditor.searchHint: Type to search for users or groups to authorize

move.title: Move: {{name}}
move.budgetScope: This budget and everything under it will be funded by the destination budget from then on.
move.projectScope: This project will be funded by the destination budget from then on.
move.requirement: You must manage both the current and the new location, and the destination needs enough free capacity.

myProjects.intro: A project is your own space in the DHBW cloud with the resources you request.
myProjects.noneCanRequest: You don't have any projects yet. Click “New project” to get started — budgets marked “Instant” create it right away.
myProjects.none: You don't have any projects yet, and no budget currently accepts requests from you. Ask your lecturer or administrator to add you to a budget.

principalSearch.unreachable: The group directory is not reachable — no suggestions. You can still type a token by hand.

projectCard.overcommittedWithAmount: Uses {{amount}} in OpenStack, more than granted. The budget is charged the larger figure, and creating new resources is blocked.
projectCard.overcommitted: The project currently uses more in OpenStack than was granted. Creating new resources is blocked.
projectCard.adoptionQueued: Queued for adoption — the next synchronization run will bring this project under management.
projectCard.importedManager: This project exists in OpenStack but is not managed here yet. Use “Adopt” to place it under a budget.
projectCard.imported: This project exists in OpenStack but is not managed here. It cannot be edited.
projectCard.inUseHint: Charged to the budget instead of the granted amount.

projectForm.budgetHint: Every project lives under a budget that provides its resources.
projectForm.budgetPlaceholder: Choose where to request this project
projectForm.budgetNone: You cannot request a project right now — ask your lecturer or administrator to add you to a budget.
projectForm.prefilled: Resources pre-filled with the most this budget approves instantly for you: {{amount}}. Ask for less and it is still instant.
projectForm.name: Name
projectForm.nameHint: A short, recognizable name — this is what the project is called in OpenStack.
projectForm.nameRequired: Please give the project a name (at least 3 characters)
projectForm.purposeHint: What is this project for? Shown to the people who approve it.
projectForm.purposePlaceholder: e.g. Lab exercises for the Distributed Systems course
projectForm.purposeRequired: Please describe the purpose (at least 5 characters)
projectForm.endDateInPast: The end date must be in the future
projectForm.endDateAfterBudget: The budget ends on {{date}} — the project cannot run longer
projectForm.membersEmpty: Nobody else has access yet. You (the owner) always do.
projectForm.belowInUseTitle: Below what the project already uses
projectForm.belowInUse: OpenStack keeps the existing servers running and only refuses new ones, so this does not free anything up — the project stays over its quota until the resources are actually released.
projectForm.outcomeBlocked: This budget grants no more than your share, and it takes no requests beyond that. Ask for less, or ask one of its managers to raise your share.
projectForm.outcomeRefused: More than this budget has free — creating the project will be refused. Lower the amount, or raise the budget first.
projectForm.outcomeDirect: You manage this budget — the project is created right away.
projectForm.outcomeInstantChange: Takes effect right away — no approval needed.
projectForm.outcomeInstant: Created right away — this budget approves it automatically.
projectForm.outcomeWaitingPolicyChange: More than this budget approves automatically. A manager decides, and until then the project keeps its current resources.
projectForm.outcomeWaitingPolicy: More than this budget approves automatically. A manager of this budget decides.
projectForm.outcomeWaitingChange: A manager decides. Until then the project keeps its current resources.
projectForm.outcomeWaiting: A manager of this budget decides on this request.

quotaInputs.exceedsFree: Exceeds the {{free}} still free in that budget — a manager would have to raise it first.
quotaInputs.freeShare: {{free}} free in that budget · this takes {{share}}%
quotaInputs.grantedOrNot: Must be granted or not granted

reject.title: Reject request
reject.changeNote: Only the proposed change is discarded — the project keeps running with its current resources.
reject.reasonRequired: Please give a reason (at least 5 characters) — the requester will see it.

roleSwitch.searchPlaceholder: Search a user, or type any email…
roleSwitch.noMatch: No match — a full email works anyway.

rootAdmin.title: OpenStack Sync Status
rootAdmin.triggered: Sync triggered. Refresh status in a moment.
rootAdmin.overdueTitle: Overdue projects, from the command line
rootAdmin.overdueText: Every managed project carries its termination date as the tag <1>{{tag}}</1>, so this lists what has run out — straight from OpenStack, with your own credentials sourced. Projects without a date carry no tag and never appear.
rootAdmin.preseedTitle: Some users could not be prepared in OpenStack
rootAdmin.preseedText: These people did not get their role. Their OpenStack account is ambiguous — most often the OIDC username differs from the email address. Assign the role to the correct account by hand, or correct the username; the next sync retries.

shell.renderErrorMessage: Switch to another section or reload the page. If it persists, a record here may be malformed.

pending.label: Awaiting approval
pending.description: Requested, but nothing exists yet. Someone who manages the paying budget has to approve it first.

approved.label: Active
approved.description: Approved and running. The OpenStack project exists and the resources shown here are reserved for you.

change_pending.label: Change requested
change_pending.description: A change is waiting for a decision. Until it is approved the project keeps running on its previous limits, and those are what it costs.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: The request was turned down. Nothing was created and nothing is charged to the budget.

released.label: Released
released.description: You gave this project up. It stays listed — and keeps using its budget — until OpenStack has actually deleted it, because until then the machines are still running. This cannot be undone.

imported.label: Imported
imported.description: Found in OpenStack but not managed here — it was created outside the self-service. It has to be adopted into a budget before it can be changed.

provisioning.label: Setting up
provisioning.description: Approved. The OpenStack project is being created — this usually takes a few minutes.

transferOwner.title: Transfer ownership: {{name}}
transferOwner.explain: The owner is the person responsible for a project — they can edit it, request changes and release it.
transferOwner.newOwnerHint: Email address of the person taking over.
transferOwner.newOwnerRequired: Please enter the new owner’s email address
